decision.observation: The goose is upright beside the hedge, facing northeast; the cup is mostly hidden behind its body near the rock wall, so it is not held.
decision.hypothesis: Moving south onto open grass will expose the cup and allow a cleaner northward approach instead of repeated turns against the hedge.
decision.memory: The cup must be ahead of the body before bending. Pre-aim before grabbing, and confirm pickup only if the cup visibly follows the beak.
